methodology: Lexical named PHP method extraction ignoring comments/quoted literals; exact source bodies, hashes and lines retained. Visibility and own/inherited declarations matched against locked framework source. Not PHP reflection or runtime observation. URL aliases and unknown fallback are represented as rules.
alias_rules: PHP method_exists/ReflectionMethod method names are case insensitive; case variants not enumerated
a__b can be requested as /a/b or /a__b for general API routes
multiple __ sequences can appear inside one segment; dispatcher does not prohibit them
fixed file/dav/{action} shadows generic file/{method}/{action}; resolves dav__{action} only
unmatched deeper api URLs can reach Index fallback, not universally 404
